# Heat and the shared tap

The tap queue is longest when the sun is already high. People with early shifts cannot join the suggested morning watering time. Installed a small storage barrel near the furthest bed and tested who could lift the filled cans. [[Garden notebook]] needs capacity in ordinary hands, not merely litres written on a container.
